mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing partly cloudy skies and 81 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in its third quarter, and as we look toward tonight, we are anticipating an overnight low of 66 degrees with rain expected.

The City of Verona has some great updates. You can now volunteer as a pilot or sign up for a free ride on a tri-shaw bike at the Senior Center. Additionally, the city is offering a rebate program for residents who install rain barrels to help manage stormwater.
There is plenty to do in town. Today, join in for trivia at Hop Haus or at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, check out the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or catch some trivia at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to the arrest of a driver for an O W I offence.
Today is the perfect day for some Butter Pecan, so make sure to stop by Culvers. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to grab a scoop.
